thread:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp shows a reproducible pause when token refresh coincides with bulk pagination. Not seeing 429s from API but SDK-side backpressure spikes and JS/Py SDKs behave differently. Anyone looked into SDK parity here?

lucas: saw a variant of this. Which SDKs?

anya: both JS and Python. JS prefetch pump seems to requeue aggressively; Py's paginator yields and serializes more, so UX differs. Repro: 10 parallel clients, pageSize=25, force refresh at ~8s.

jordan: curious that parity differs. Could be the retry/backoff default or how auth hooks adjust concurrency slots.

anya: short logs from one run:
[2026-03-23T12:08:02Z] fetchPage(c=7,page=3) -> 200 lat=95ms
[2026-03-23T12:08:09Z] auth.refresh(c=7) -> 200
[2026-03-23T12:08:09Z] js-sdk:window.set(old=6,new=1,reason=auth_event)
[2026-03-23T12:08:09Z] py-sdk:window.set(old=6,new=2,reason=auth_event)
[2026-03-23T12:08:09Z] enqueue(c=2,page=6) queued=8 wait=4.3s

lucas: aha js clamps to 1, py to 2. That explains different stall magnitude. We should unify heuristics across SDKs. Parity bug.

jordan: agree. Also the prefetch pump behavior differs: JS pump will attempt to refill up to a hard target (based on historical window), while Py keeps target tied to current slots. That mismatch amplifies queueing in JS.

anya: proposal: (1) unify clamp heuristic: on successful token refresh, floor = max(2, ceil(old*0.25)) instead of absolute 1. (2) prefetch target = max(1, floor(current_slots * prefetch_factor)) so pump scales with observed window.

lucas: +1. Also add "auth-grace-ms": short soft-credit period (default 250ms) after refresh so in-flight pipeline can drain. If errors appear we revoke credits.

jordan: we should also ensure retry backoff behavior is consistent: JS retries currently jitter-expo with base 200ms, Py uses 100ms. Align defaults and surface env toggles for testing.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-12890 "sdk-parity: align auth clamp, prefetch target, and retry defaults across SDKs" and attached logs.

anya: test plan: deterministic e2e job that advances clock, forces TTL boundary with 10 clients, asserts mean queue <2s and 99p <6s for both SDKs. Will add a toggle to run in CI.

lucas: I'll open a small patch in JS SDK to change clamp and pump logic; jordan can mirror in Py. Leave defaults behind SDK_EXPERIMENT_AUTH_CLAMP env var.

jordan: I'll sync retry base backoff to 200ms and add unit tests for prefetch scaling.

anya: docs note: add short onboarding tip: "During heavy paginated scans, aim for token refresh margin >30s or enable long-lived tokens to avoid client-side backpressure interactions."

lucas: after patches land let's run sampleapp-load (https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp-load) and watch per-client wait histograms and prefetch buffer depth.

anya: thanks — will PR tests + links here when ready. :thumbsup:
